notes: Cap on Liability spans for Sections 11.3 and 8.5 are each split across a mid-sentence page-number break in the source (page markers "12" and "9"); the two halves of each clause are given as separate spans rather than bridged, per span discipline. IP Ownership Assignment is a No: Sections 12.1.1/12.1.2 have each party's Intellectual Property, including IP it creates while performing under the Agreement, remain that party's own sole property (a retention structure, not an assignment to the counterparty); Section 9.6 makes User Data jointly owned by both parties upon termination, which is joint ownership rather than an assignment to one counterparty, so it was not counted either (borderline). Non-Compete is a No: Section 12.2 ("Parallel Agreement") restricts VerticalNet from partnering with the named third party Futurestep, Inc., which reads as an exclusivity/no-deal-with-named-competitor commitment rather than a restriction on VerticalNet's own competitive activity or operating scope, so it was excluded per the operational rule distinguishing Exclusivity from Non-Compete (borderline, flagged).
